profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: 30MW operating as of July 2022 per Global Energy Monitor, expansion to 100MW announced but not confirmed built. Compute North filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2022; local news (nebraska.tv) reported the Kearney facility continued operating despite the filing, but current post-bankruptcy ownership was not independently reconfirmed this session -- operator left as Compute North on file, flagging for a follow-up ownership check.

reading.body:
This campus in Buffalo County published 30 megawatts of IT capacity as of July 2022. At 40 kilowatts per rack, a common density for AI training, 30 megawatts of IT load converts to roughly 750 racks. An announced expansion to 100 megawatts was never confirmed as built.

Compute North filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2022, one month after this facility was reported operating. Local news reported the site continued operating after the filing, but current post-bankruptcy ownership is not independently confirmed as of this reading. The operator name on file remains Compute North pending a follow-up verification.

Nebraska has 21 mapped data center facilities on record. This campus is the only one in the state with a published megawatt figure, making it rank first by disclosed capacity. No other facility in Nebraska has released specifications to this site, so the state's actual operating capacity is unknown and likely substantially larger than the single confirmed figure here.
